set.title: Menguji Kapan Pedagogical Agent Benar-Benar Membantu Proses Belajar
set.titleEn: Testing When a Pedagogical Agent Actually Helps Learning
set.summary: Saya merancang 2×2 mixed-factorial experiment dengan 157 partisipan untuk menguji apakah visible pedagogical agent membantu psychomotor dan cognitive learning task dengan cara yang sama. Agent meningkatkan psychomotor performance dan self-efficacy, tetapi tidak meningkatkan cognitive performance dan sedikit menurunkan cognitive self-efficacy. Saya juga memvalidasi AI-based gesture scoring terhadap manual scoring (r=.842) dan mengecek temuan utama dengan robust analysis ketika statistical assumptions tidak terpenuhi dengan baik.
set.summaryEn: I designed a 2×2 mixed-factorial study with 157 participants to test whether a visible pedagogical agent helps psychomotor and cognitive learning tasks in the same way. The agent improved psychomotor performance and self-efficacy, but did not improve cognitive performance and slightly reduced cognitive self-efficacy. I also validated AI-based gesture scoring against manual ratings (r=.842) and checked the key findings with robust models when statistical assumptions were not clean.
